messages:
maya: Kicking off region-by-region rollout for v2.4.1. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Targets: US -> EU -> APAC. Will pin EU to v2.4.0 if any regressions.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout started for v2.4.1 (canary=5% traffic) in us-west-2 at 2412345682. Check /deploy status for logs. :rocket:
liam: Quick capacity check — can we run a warm pool in eu-west-1 before cutover?
ops-oncall: Running quick cluster health and GPU headroom check now.
ops-oncall: us-west-2 GPU util avg 62%, queue depth 3, latency p95 210ms — looks healthy.
emma: thx — can we confirm memory pressure on eu? last run had a KV cache spike.
ops-oncall: eu-west-1 warm pool exists but only 8 nodes warm. Suggested warm to 12 before pushing traffic.
alex: Increase warm pool to 12, ramp over 10m. Also enable traffic slice 10% -> 30% -> 60% per 5m.
maya: noted. Pin settings: eu fallback -> v2.4.0, pin window 30m after initial ramp.
deploy-bot: Action: scale warm-pool eu-west-1 to 12 replicas. Started at 2412345720.
ops-oncall: warm pool hit 12 at 2412345780. GPU util during warm-up ~45%.
liam: smoke tests — can someone run the prompt-latency harness against eu canary?
alex: running now: 
```
./tools/miniharness --region eu-west-1 --model rwd-open-7b --sequence 256 --runs 50
```
ops-oncall: smoke results: mean latency 240ms, p95 420ms, error rate 0.6% (transient timeout spikes).
maya: 0.6% is within threshold but those timeouts worry me. Cause?
ops-oncall: digging — saw a short KV cache miss storm during ramp; autoscaler handled but produced tails.
liam: set transient backpressure rule to 350ms p95 for eu slice and enable KV cache prefetch for recent prefixes.
alex: do we want to proceed to EU cutover or hold? my vote: hold 15m, observe after prefetch enabled.
maya: agree. Hold for 15m and re-run harness. If stable, proceed to APAC after 30m. If not, rollback EU to v2.4.0.
deploy-bot: Hold applied. Next check scheduled at 2412345880.
ops-oncall: re-run harness started.
ops-oncall: re-run results: mean 230ms, p95 320ms, error rate 0.2% — prefetch helped.
maya: thanks. Proceeding with EU ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 100% per 10m. Pin fallback remains ready.
deploy-bot: EU ramp to 40% at 2412345920. Canary update notes: release notes link https://internal/release/v2.4.1 — includes batching improvements and KV prefetch toggle.
liam: leaving a note for support to watch for convo-quality regressions (prompt eval set #prod-smoke).
emma: also flag emb-ops for any embedding throughput regressions in APAC.
alex: APAC plan: provision extra warm nodes in ap-southeast-1 to 14, sequence similar.
maya: final decision: continue to APAC after EU reaches stable 40% for 20m. If at any point p95 > 500ms OR error rate > 1% we rollback EU to v2.4.0 and abort APAC.
deploy-bot: Rollback mechanism: pinned fallback route prepared (v2.4.0) for eu-west-1; manual trigger via /deploy rollback eu-west-1 v2.4.0 or automated if critical errors exceed thresholds.
alex: I'll be on-call during APAC cutover window.
liam: noted. I'll prepare a short rollback runbook snippet in case we hit the KV cold-start regression.
maya: thanks everyone. Post-release checklist: update release notes with observed perf numbers, close ticket INF-1423 once APAC is at 100%.
ops-oncall: logging final metrics to dashboards. Will post link in 10m. :white_check_mark:
